name: Breedon EURUSD US-session long

source.title: Intraday Patterns in FX Returns and Order Flow
source.type: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking; 2011 SNB working-paper text

mandatory_same_session_close: Sell at 16:00 America/New_York on the same date.
max_entry_rule_origin: Selected research specification; one initial entry, no same-day re-entry. This cap is not an observed frequency.
observed_trade_frequency: NOT REPORTED for this exact selected specification

source_rules.indicator: Fixed local clock session; no signal indicator beyond calendar time.
source_rules.exit: Sell at 16:00 America/New_York on the same date.
source_rules.position_sizing: NOT SPECIFIED; fixed notional for replication is a proposal.
source_rules.cost_treatment: Authors use EBS firm bid/ask; retail broker spread and slippage untested.

source_reported_performance: Author-reported annualized trading return 0.07 (7%) and Sharpe 0.9 after EBS spread; no independent recent replication verified.
source_sample: EBS spot FX 1997–2007; latest decade not tested.
known_risks: Old interdealer sample; broker spread and changing FX flows.
data_requirements: EURUSD spot tick or M1 bid/ask history and both Europe/London and America/New_York daylight-saving calendars.
proposed_adaptations_not_source_validate: Skip bank holidays only if predeclared, use broker quotes for the intended venue, no synthetic 5pm FX day boundary, one entry maximum. Test any protective stop separately.

research_score.meaning: Research priority judgment; not probability of profitability

evidence_status: Journal study, old EBS bid/ask sample
special_case: Eight-hour holding exceeds preferred four hours but is intraday and directly tested in historical source.
